name: Hana Kago
description: A romantic, lush store theme for florists who sell bouquets, baskets, dried flowers, wreaths and flower subscriptions online: blush-paper pages with a faint paper grain drawn in CSS, coral petals and deep leaf green, DM Serif Display headings with its italic for the tender words over DM Sans text; a header that lies transparent over the photograph and turns into blush paper as you scroll, a home page laid out as a pressed-flower masonry where every bouquet, quote and note sits on a card with soft, deckled paper edges and a slight tilt, and a leaf-green footer led by the Monday stem letter; with delivery (areas, cut-off times and fees) and subscription (weekly, fortnightly, monthly) pages, about, a journal, a newsletter and contact, the shop details and the delivery table each kept in one synced pattern so they are edited once, and WooCommerce shop, product, cart, checkout and account templates styled to match.

fonts.role: headings, the wordmark, prices, quotes and the italic tender words

store.withoutPlugin: The shop page shows every bouquet, basket, dried posy, wreath and subscription with its photograph and price, and orders go by phone or email; store templates are not used.
